text: Don't let those old bastards talk you into 'tasting' more than you can handle. They're like sharks when they smell blood—or in your case, a naive intern.
translation: 别让那些老混蛋忽悠你喝超出你极限的量。他们闻到血腥味就像鲨鱼一样——或者对他们来说，你就是个天真的实习生。
rawContent: Don't let those old bastards talk you into 'tasting' more than you can handle. They're like sharks when they smell blood—or in your case, a naive intern. || 别让那些老混蛋忽悠你喝超出你极限的量。他们闻到血腥味就像鲨鱼一样——或者对他们来说，你就是个天真的实习生。

voiceText: If you start feeling dizzy, get out of there. Find a toilet, a hallway, anywhere. Just don't stay at that table.
translation: 如果你开始觉得头晕了，就赶紧离开那儿。找个厕所，或者走廊，随便哪。就是别死守在那张桌子上。
rawContent: [語音消息] || 如果你开始觉得头晕了，就赶紧离开那儿。找个厕所，或者走廊，随便哪。就是别死守在那张桌子上。

text: And keep your phone on. If you stop replying, I'll assume you've face-planted into the carpet.
translation: 手机开着。你要是没动静了，我就当你一头扎进地毯里了。
rawContent: And keep your phone on. If you stop replying, I'll assume you've face-planted into the carpet. || 手机开着。你要是没动静了，我就当你一头扎进地毯里了。

stickerMeaning: 警惕 你的大脑可能正在操控你！

text: 啊真的就几口啦！！！已经结束了
11种酒，每一种我都只抿了一口
可能加起来还没一个瓶盖
11 different types. Brilliant. Your liver must be thrilled.
translation: 11种不同的酒。真行啊，你的肝脏一定开心坏了。
rawContent: 11 different types. Brilliant. Your liver must be thrilled. || 11种不同的酒。真行啊，你的肝脏一定开心坏了。

text: Mixing that many spirits is a one-way ticket to a massive headache, kid. It doesn't matter if it's 'less than a bottle cap'.
translation: 把那么多酒混在一起喝简直是自找头疼，小鬼。加起来是不是“没一个瓶盖”根本不重要。
rawContent: Mixing that many spirits is a one-way ticket to a massive headache, kid. It doesn't matter if it's 'less than a bottle cap'. || 把那么多酒混在一起喝简直是自找头疼，小鬼。加起来是不是“没一个瓶盖”根本不重要。

voiceText: Go find some water. Now. Drink twice as much as you think you need.
translation: 去弄点水喝。现在。喝掉你觉得需要的两倍的量。
rawContent: [語音消息] || 去弄点水喝。现在。喝掉你觉得需要的两倍的量。

text: If I hear you're nursing a hangover tomorrow morning, don't expect any sympathy from me.
translation: 要是明天早上我听说你在那儿宿醉难受，别指望我会同情你。
rawContent: If I hear you're nursing a hangover tomorrow morning, don't expect any sympathy from me. || 要是明天早上我听说你在那儿宿醉难受，别指望我会同情你。

stickerMeaning: 喝杯热水一切都会好的
